newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Egana to up stake in Peace Mark.
newsitem.headline: Egana to up stake in Peace Mark.

text.p: Peace Mark (Holdings) Ltd said on Thursday Egana International (Holdings) Ltd will increase its stake in the company to 22.83 percent from 20.23 percent by exercising its warrants rights.

Peace Mark said fellow watchmaker Egana had decided to exercise the rights on its entire holding of Peace Mark's 1998 warrants to subscribe for 31.24 million new Peace Mark shares at HK$0.30 each. It gave no date for the deal.
Egana will hold 218.68 million Peace Mark shares following the exercise of the warrants, up from 187.44 million shares, it said.
